items.item: No synchronous callout in trigger/before-save; uses async pattern
items.evidence: "A callout can't happen in the save transaction or in a before-save flow." Recommends an after-save flow or trigger handler that enqueues an Apex Queueable, which makes the callout.

items.item: Uses Named Credential and External Credential, no hard-coded URL or secret
items.evidence: "Create a Named Credential `ERP_Orders` pointing at `https://erp.example.com`, with an External Credential for authentication... Apex calls `callout:ERP_Orders/api/orders`. The URL and secrets are never hard-coded"

items.item: Covers failure handling: retries, logging or error record
items.evidence: "Timeouts and 5xx: capped retries (for example 3) with backoff, by re-enqueueing..."; fields `ERP_Sync_Status__c`, `ERP_Last_Error__c`, `ERP_Attempts__c`; a log object `ERP_Sync_Log__c`; a sweep job.
